full_text: The permit to extract sand, gravel and other quarry resources shall be issued exclusively by the provincial governor, pursuant to the ordinance of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan. The proceeds of the tax on sand, gravel and other quarry resources shall be distributed as follows: (4) Province - Thirty percent (30%); (5) Component City or Municipality where the sand, gravel, and other quarry resources are extracted - Thirty percent (30%); and (6) Barangay where the sand, gravel, and other quarry resources are extracted - Forty percent (40%).
